an10.70:2.1: LXX. Dasa yimāni bhikkhave pāsaṃsāni ṭhānāni. Katamāni dasa? Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu attanā ca appiccho hoti appicchakathañ ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā hoti. Appiccho bhikkhu appicchakathañ ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā ti pāsaṃsam etaṃ ṭhānaṃ.
an10.70:3.1: Attanā ca santuṭṭho hoti santuṭṭhikathañ ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā hoti. Santuṭṭho bhikkhu santuṭṭhikathañ ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā ti pāsaṃsam etaṃ ṭhānaṃ.
an10.70:4.1: Attanā ca pavivitto hoti pavivekakathañ ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā hoti. Pavivitto bhikkhu pavivekakathañ ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā ti pāsaṃsam etaṃ ṭhānaṃ.
an10.70:5.1: Attanā ca asaṃsaṭṭho hoti asaṃsaggakathañ ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā hoti. Asaṃsaṭṭho bhikkhu asaṃsaggakathañ ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā ti pāsaṃsam etaṃ ṭhānaṃ.
an10.70:6.1: Attanā ca āraddhaviriyo hoti viriyārambhakathañ ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā hoti. Āraddhaviriyo bhikkhu viriyārambhakathañ ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā ti pāsaṃsam etaṃ ṭhānaṃ.
an10.70:7.1: Attanā ca sīlasampanno hoti sīlasampadākathañ ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā hoti. Sīlasampanno bhikkhu sīlasampadākathañ ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā ti pāsaṃsam etaṃ ṭhānaṃ.
an10.70:8.1: Attanā ca samādhisampanno hoti samādhisampadākathañ ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā hoti. Samādhisampanno bhikkhu samādhisampadākathañ ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā ti pāsaṃsam etaṃ ṭhānaṃ.
an10.70:9.1: Attanā ca paññāsampanno hoti paññāsampadākathañ ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā hoti. Paññāsampanno bhikkhu paññāsampadākathañ ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā ti pāsaṃsam etaṃ ṭhānaṃ.
an10.70:10.1: Attanā ca vimuttisampanno hoti vimuttisampadākathañ ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā hoti. Vimuttisampanno bhikkhu vimuttisampadākathañ ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā ti pāsaṃsam etaṃ ṭhānaṃ.
an10.70:11.1: Attanā ca vimuttiñāṇadassanasampanno hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanasampadākathañ ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā hoti. Vimuttiñāṇadassanasampanno bhikkhu vimuttiñāṇadassanasampadākathañ ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā ti pāsaṃsam etaṃ ṭhānaṃ.
an10.70:12.1: Imāni kho bhikkhave dasa pāsaṃsāni ṭhānānī ti. Yamakavaggo sattamo.
an10.70:13.0: Tatr' uddānaṃ: Avijjā taṇhā niṭṭhā ca avecca dve sukhāni ca Naḷakapāne dve vuttā kathāvatthu apare dve ti.
